rules.name: Instacart+ membership (3 months) and $20 monthly Instacart credit
rules.eligibility_notes: Instacart purchases while the Instacart+ membership is active and paid with the card. Complimentary three-month Instacart+ membership; activated members get a $20 monthly Instacart credit. Benefit ends 2027-12-31. The page does not say whether unused credit rolls over. Requires enrollment/activation of Instacart+ with the card. Membership auto-renews at $99 per year after the complimentary period unless canceled.
